text:
sylvia: FYI — were rolling out a Monthly Free Credit Reconciliation change on 2026-12-01 UTC. This affects free-tier rollups, invoice CSV, and the billing API.

sylvia: TL;DR: unused free credits from the previous month will be reconciled into a single `monthly_reconcile_credit` line (capped at $150/account) rather than itemized per-day. Aim is clearer invoices and fewer small adjustments.

omar: Finance: new invoice CSV adds columns: monthly_reconcile_credit, monthly_reconcile_amount. Retro adjustments window: 30 days. Credits non-refundable.

ben: Eng note: no change to unit prices. Metering will aggregate daily free credit consumption server-side. New API flag /v1/invoices?reconcile_monthly=true to opt in for detailed view. Old behavior remains for 60 days after launch.

support-bot: Suggested canned reply for support: "We now consolidate unused free credits into one monthly credit line to simplify billing. This won't change your overage pricing or SLAs."

omar: Dedicated/reserved customers excluded from automatic reconciliation — they keep contract statements. We will surface a callout in the console explaining the change.

sylvia: Action items: @omar publish sample invoice CSV, @ben publish API flag doc + deprecation notice, @support-bot add canned replies. Banner goes live 7 days before launch.

ben: I'll add the reconcile_monthly toggle to invoices API and post a short migration note in docs today.

sylvia: Thanks all — ping here for questions or to request exclusion lists.
